newsitem.title: UK: UK building output still up but pace slower - survey.
newsitem.headline: UK building output still up but pace slower - survey.

text.p: The UK construction industry reported its fifth quarterly increase in output in a row in the second quarter, according to a Construction Confederation survey released on Tuesday.
But the group added that the rate of growth was slower than the preceding quarter.
The survey showed a seasonally-adjusted balance of +12 percent of companies reporting a rise in second-quarter output versus +37 percent in the first quarter.
All companies reported success in tendering for new work and tender prices continued to rise, but higher costs meant that tender margins remained static.
The industry said the main problems facing it over the coming months were labour shortages, which were putting upward pressure on wage inflation, sterling strength and rising interest rates.
In the second-quarter, 41 percent of companies surveyed worked at full or near capacity, a small rise on the first quarter. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
